stories.summary: How does your team look in 2026-27? What about in 2029? NBA insiders unveil the latest rankings, based on five key metrics.

stories.title: Seahawks rule QB Darnold (glute) out vs. Cardinals on Sunday
stories.summary: The Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday's game against the Cardinals due to the glute injury he suffered in Wednesday's season-opening win.

stories.title: Vikings RB Mason placed on IR after having surgery on thumb
stories.summary: Vikings running back Jordan Mason was placed on injured reserve Wednesday after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured thumb.

stories.title: Colts WR Allen charged with OWI, allegedly blew .224 on test
stories.summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

stories.title: LSU's Umanmielen served court papers from Ole Miss suit ahead of showdown
stories.summary: The LSU-Ole Miss rivalry took another dramatic turn Tuesday when Tigers star defensive end Princewill Umanmielen was served with court papers related to the Rebels' lawsuit against him, according to court records.
